items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: I was making the monkey shine while Emmanuel was carrying that melody... that little Ricker band

ctx.x: Most of the younger fellas, we've talked to them, I'm wondering about those old timers that are dead now that we'll never know anything about unless somebody like you tells us. Yeah, or some fella tells us. Who were your favorite trumpet players? Who did you like best of all?
Well, I liked Emmanuel Peres. I liked Emmanuel Peres above all the trumpet players because…
Did he play most legitimate or did he play good jazz? He made things, everything was clean on his horn and he was powerful.
